meta.title: Solo Living Diary
meta.description: A life sim from the day you start your first job and leave home to your early 30s, driven only by choices: buy or skip, high, mid or low.
meta.setInJapan: Set in Japan. All amounts are in Japanese yen.

title.lead:
From leaving home to your 30s,
a life sim made only of choices
